false_negatives.finding: The decompressed .fp32 payload is not bound to input bytes/elements or exact torch.float32 dtype. A three-byte raw payload for a one-element four-byte input and a torch.float16 input label both pass after internally consistent SHA resealing.
Decompressed FP32 values are not reconciled with the recorded active/positive/negative/nonfinite statistics. A +1.0 value with all-zero input statistics passes.

Support-plane extents are self-declared rather than derived as ceil(input.elements/8) per plane. A scalar input with two-byte positive and two-byte negative planes passes. The author's positive fixture also assigns one-byte planes to decoder tensors with millions of elements.

Support-plane contents are not bound to decompressed raw signs or zero padding. A +1.0 raw value encoded in the negative plane and nonzero out-of-range padding bits both pass after record/seal/actual SHA resealing.
zlib.decompress accepts a valid stream followed by trailing garbage. The validator hashes only the returned raw prefix and does not require stream EOF with no unused_data/unconsumed_tail.

Attention NPZ schema is subset-only and packbits padding is ignored. An invented archive member and nonzero bits beyond the declared [2,W,H,N,D] extent both pass after exact record/seal/actual SHA resealing.

minimum_additive_successor: Require every retained input dtype to be exactly torch.float32 and decompressed raw length to equal both input.bytes and input.elements*4; decode little-endian FP32 and recompute active/positive/negative/nonfinite statistics.

Derive each support plane extent as ceil(input.elements/8), require exact two-plane file length, zero all tail padding, prohibit positive/negative overlap, and compare both planes bit-for-bit with decoded FP32 signs.
Use zlib.decompressobj and require eof true with empty unused_data and unconsumed_tail so only one complete canonical stream is admitted.
Require the attention NPZ key set exactly, not as a subset, and require unused q/k packbits tail bits to be zero.

Preserve all M1333/M1335 identity, order, calls, dtype, geometry, SHA, runtime, symlink, cohort, ep34 and admission gates; add tests for all nine accepted mutations and obtain another different-author recursive-seal review before touching canonical.
